snippet.title: The 6-Year-Old Voice on Michael Jackson’s “Stranger in Moscow” | 1994 Studio Footage
snippet.description:
1994 studio recording from The Hit Factory, New York.

Michael Jackson recorded a young Russian voice for “Stranger in Moscow” during the HIStory sessions. The vocalist was six-year-old Danila Medvedev, also credited as Daniel Brandon. The recorded line is “Privyet, Michael.”

Jackson directed the session himself. The line appears after the second chorus on the album version. The spoken Russian passage at the end of the song is a separate adult performance.

This footage was filmed by engineer Brad Sundberg and released publicly in 2023. Danila Medvedev later confirmed that he was the child in the session.

Sources
YouTube (studio footage, 2023): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AsfXIamwp6A

Instagram (Danila Medvedev): https://www.instagram.com/danilamedvedevv/

Instagram confirmation post (2022): https://www.instagram.com/reel/Ch2pidGgTsU/

Footage: Brad Sundberg / In The Studio With MJ
Vocal: Danila Medvedev
Song: Michael Jackson — “Stranger in Moscow” (HIStory, 1995)
Studio: The Hit Factory, New York

snippet.title: UFC Fighter Bilal Hasan Calls His Debut on Michael Jackson’s Birthday a “Prophecy”
snippet.description:
Undefeated flyweight prospect Bilal Hasan is set to make his UFC debut on August 29 at UFC Shanghai — a date that holds special meaning for the fighter.

Hasan, a lifelong Michael Jackson fan, will step into the Octagon on the King of Pop’s birthday. Reflecting on the timing, he said:

“It still feels so surreal to be halfway across the world fighting in China on August 29th on Michael Jackson’s birthday. Sounds like something out of like a prophecy or something like that. It still doesn’t feel real.”

The 25-year-old, nicknamed “The IndoNinja,” earned his UFC contract with a dominant 45-second knockout on Dana White’s Contender Series just weeks earlier. Born in Hawaii and of Indonesian descent, Hasan remains undefeated as a professional and will face fellow newcomer Nilson Rojas in his promotional debut.

A devoted Michael Jackson fan since childhood, Hasan has previously celebrated wins with moonwalks and has confirmed he has a special walkout planned for this historic night.

Source: UFC News

snippet.title: Russian Fan Dedicates Mount Elbrus Climb (5,642m) to Michael Jackson | Powerful Tribute
snippet.description:
A dedicated fan from Tyrnyauz, Russia’s highest-altitude city, has successfully climbed Mount Elbrus — the highest peak in Europe at 5,642 metres — and dedicated the entire ascent to Michael Jackson.

She carried a poster of the King of Pop all the way to the summit as a heartfelt tribute.
A teaser of this special climb will be released on August 29.

What a powerful and emotional dedication from the Caucasus mountains.

snippet.title: Spike Lee’s Michael Jackson Block Party Returns for His 68th Birthday
snippet.description:
Spike Lee is bringing back his annual Michael Jackson Block Party in Brooklyn — on the day the King of Pop would have turned 68.

Event: BK Loves MJ
Date: Saturday, August 29, 2026
Place: Fort Greene Park, Brooklyn
Time: 12:00 PM – 7:00 PM
Entry: Free
DJ: DJ Spinna
Sponsor: Jordan Brand

The tradition started on August 29, 2009, weeks after Michael Jackson’s passing. The first celebration was planned for Fort Greene Park, then moved to Prospect Park because the crowd was too large. Brooklyn even declared it Michael Jackson Day.

Over the years the party has moved between Prospect Park, Bed-Stuy, and Fort Greene. After a four-year break, it returned in 2023 with tens of thousands of fans.

This year’s event comes after the success of the Michael biopic starring Jaafar Jackson, which introduced a new generation to his music.

Would you be in Fort Greene on the 29th?

snippet.title: Paris Jackson with Aunt La Toya at Happiest Day of My Life Album Launch
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson is joined by her aunt La Toya Jackson at the private launch party for her sophomore album Happiest Day of My Life.

The album was released on August 21, 2026 through Republic Records. It is Paris’s first full-length project in six years after her 2020 debut Wilted. The 11-track record leans into alternative and rock sounds, with contributions from Linda Perry, Butch Walker and Jason Lader.

La Toya attended the gathering on the night of the release to support her niece. This clip captures a quiet family moment from that evening.

Irankunda is a genuine Michael Jackson fan who has often spoken about his love for the King of Pop. He once said, “Everywhere I go, I listen to MJ,” and has previously celebrated goals with MJ-inspired dance moves and a sparkling glove.

Sporting CP leaned into this connection and created one of the most creative transfer announcements in recent football — a pure tribute to Michael Jackson’s ‘Bad’ era.
A rising football talent meeting the lasting influence of the King of Pop.

snippet.title: REAL LIFE THRILLER Ride in France | Michael Jackson Ghost Train at Luna Park
snippet.description:
A giant three-level ghost train fully inspired by Michael Jackson’s Thriller is currently operating at Luna Park in Palavas-les-Flots, France.

Created in 2013 by French showman Stéphane Camors, this unique attraction features live zombie actors, animatronics, special effects, a 120-metre track, and a large dancing figure on the roof.

The idea for the ride came when Camors saw his children watching the legendary John Landis-directed Thriller music video. His family has been building funfair attractions for nearly 150 years.

The ride is open every day from 7pm to 1am until 30 August 2026 at Luna Park’s new location on Allée des Loisirs.

This is not an official Michael Jackson estate attraction — it’s an independent tribute built purely out of love for the iconic 1983 video.

If you’re in the south of France this summer, this is a must-visit for any MJ fan.
Would you ride it?

snippet.title: Michael Jackson - I Was The Loser (Unedited 2008 Demo) | NEW LEAK
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson - I Was The Loser (Unedited 2008 Demo)

Full Background:

“I Was The Loser” was originally written and recorded in January 2003 under the title “I Am A Loser”.

The song was co-written by Michael Jackson and his longtime collaborator Brad Buxer. At the time, Buxer was going through a breakup. Late one night in a hotel, Michael overheard him saying “I’m a loser, I’m just a loser,” and suggested they turn it into a song. They wrote and recorded the demo the following morning.

In late 2008, while preparing material for a new album, Michael revisited the track. He decided to change the title and the main lyric from “I Am A Loser” to “I Was The Loser” because he didn’t want to say “I am a loser.” The new chorus vocals were recorded by Michael in a makeshift studio set up by engineer Michael Prince at the Bel Air Hotel.

This version features the 2008 vocals (with mild Melodyne/autotune, which Michael himself approved).

Leak History:
• 2003 demo (“I Am A Loser”) first leaked on September 7, 2013
• 2008 version leaked on November 21, 2025
• Full unedited 2008 demo leaked on August 2, 2026 by Motif
